rawFindings.title: Incorrect Regex and Group Used in no-regex-spaces Rule
rawFindings.explanation: The changed regular expression pattern was modified from /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ to /( {2,})+?/. The original regex captures groups of multiple spaces followed by certain characters or end of line, which is needed for the rule's logic to identify excessive spaces properly. The new regex just captures multiple spaces non-greedily, losing necessary context and likely breaking rule behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert line 40 to use the original regex pattern /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ to ensure the rule matches regex spaces correctly.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect Captured Group Used to Determine Space Count
rawFindings.explanation: The code changed the way it computes the length of the matched spaces from regexResults[1].length to regexResults[0].length. The original code uses the first capturing group which correctly counts the number of spaces. The updated line counts the entire matched string including any extra characters, leading to incorrect space counting and thus wrong fix suggestions by the rule.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert line 44 to use regexResults[1].length so the count reflects the actual number of consecutive spaces.
